note: P2 wave 3 — arts, to clear the roadmap's floor of 10 rows per domain. Five rows: Creative Capital (two), United States Artists, NEA Creative Writing Fellowships and the NYSCA/NYFA Artist Fellowship. Only the NYFA row could be read directly from the funder; arts.gov, creative-capital.org and unitedstatesartists.org all needed the search index or a rendering browser. The Creative Capital State of the Art Prize is explicitly marked low confidence and flagged for re-verification or removal.

new_rows.stated_purpose: Unrestricted project grants to individual artists to create new work in the visual arts, performing arts, film and literature.
new_rows.eligibility_notes: Must be a US citizen, permanent resident, Tribal ID holder or O-1 visa holder at the time of application; at least 25 years old; at least 5 years of professional artistic practice in the chosen discipline; and not enrolled in a degree-granting programme.
new_rows.eligibility_window: At least 5 years of professional artistic practice; minimum age 25
new_rows.specific_topic: new artistic work in visual arts, performing arts, film or literature
new_rows.status_evidence: The 2027 Open Call ran with a deadline of 2 April 2026 at 3pm ET and is now closed; Creative Capital runs an annual open call.
new_rows.notes: Added 2026-09-18 (P2 arts). PROVENANCE: award amount, eligibility and deadline read through the search index and Creative Capital's 2027 Application Handbook rather than a direct fetch of the programme page, hence confidence=medium.

new_rows.program_name: Creative Capital State of the Art Prize
new_rows.stated_purpose: Unrestricted artist grants recognising work in the field.
new_rows.status_evidence: Described alongside the Creative Capital Award as a newer unrestricted grant of $10,000.
new_rows.notes: Added 2026-09-18 (P2 arts). LOW CONFIDENCE: this prize is named only in passing alongside the main Creative Capital Award; its cadence, eligibility and selection route were not established. Kept as a row because the amount and funder are attributable, but it is the weakest row in the corpus and should be re-verified or removed on the next pass.

new_rows.stated_purpose: Unrestricted awards to artists and collaboratives across ten disciplines, with access to financial planning, career consulting, legal advice and personal care services.
new_rows.eligibility_notes: Disciplines: Architecture & Design, Craft, Dance, Film, Media, Music, Theater & Performance, Traditional Arts, Visual Art, Writing. Artists cannot apply unsolicited — a rotating, anonymous group of arts professionals nominates candidates to apply each year.
new_rows.specific_topic: artistic practice across ten named disciplines
new_rows.status_evidence: United States Artists announced its 2026 cohort of 50 fellows at $50,000 each; the fellowship runs annually by nomination.
new_rows.notes: Added 2026-09-18 (P2 arts). Nomination-only, which is why submission_path is by_invitation — one of very few such rows in the corpus. PROVENANCE: read through the search index.

new_rows.stated_purpose: Fellowships enabling published creative writers to set aside time for writing, research, travel and general career advancement.
new_rows.eligibility_notes: US citizens or permanent residents who meet the publication criteria in the relevant funding opportunity. Applications are reviewed anonymously, with artistic excellence and artistic merit of the writing sample as the primary criteria.
new_rows.prior_funding_exclusion: yes: recipients of two or more NEA creative writing fellowships are ineligible
new_rows.specific_topic: creative writing (prose and poetry, in alternate years)
new_rows.review_criteria_official: Artistic excellence and artistic merit of the submitted writing sample, judged anonymously
new_rows.status_evidence: The programme runs on a two-year cycle alternating prose and poetry; FY2026 offered prose fellowships, so poetry follows in FY2027.
new_rows.notes: Added 2026-09-18 (P2 arts). `application_cadence = biennial` is literally correct here: each discipline comes round every other year. One of the few rows in the corpus with a real prior-funding exclusion. PROVENANCE: arts.gov returns HTTP 403 for this path, so the row rests on the search index.

new_rows.funder: New York Foundation for the Arts (NYFA) / New York State Council on the Arts
new_rows.stated_purpose: An unrestricted cash grant intended to fund an artist's vision or voice at all levels of their artistic development, rather than a specific project.
new_rows.eligibility_notes: Open to artists living in New York State and/or one of the Tribal Nations located therein. Awarded in fifteen disciplines over a three-year period, five categories a year; the application is free.
new_rows.specific_topic: artistic practice in the five disciplines open in a given year
new_rows.status_evidence: “The NYSCA/NYFA Artist Fellowship is an $8,000 unrestricted cash grant available to artists living in New York State and/or one of the Tribal Nations located therein”; awarded “in fifteen different disciplines over a three-year period (five categories a year)”.
new_rows.notes: Added 2026-09-18 (P2 arts). Resolved with a rendering browser (nyfa.org returns HTTP 403 to a text fetch). Note the discipline rotation: any given artist's category is open only one year in three, which `application_cadence = annual` does not capture and eligibility_notes does.
